zh: 首页用量面板的用量热力图，格子悬停提示原本写的是那天的消息条数，现在改成那天的 Token 用量（「9月9日 — 15.9k Token」），与格子深浅取自同一个数字；两份数据来源都带每天的 Token 合计，提示不再随来源换口径。
en: On the home page's usage panel, the heat map's cell tip used to name the day's messages; it now names the tokens that day spent ("Sep 9 — 15.9k tokens"), the same figure the cell's shade is bucketed from. Both sources behind the grid carry a per-day token total, so the tip no longer changes its reading with the source.
